description.value: Matsqui Recreation Centre is a City of Abbotsford municipal facility offering multi-sport programming to the broader community. Located in the Clearbrook neighbourhood, it serves as a full-service sports centre under the city's Parks, Recreation & Culture department. For touring cyclists, it represents a potential urban rest point with indoor facilities in the Abbotsford area.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (7 spaces) at 10m; rack (7 spaces) at 48m. Total: 14 spaces.
